entries.name: value
entries.description:
The name of the filter operator.
It will be matched with the `operator` property of the filter items.

entries.name: getApplyFilterFn
entries.description:
The callback that generates a filtering function for a given filter item and column.
This function can return `null` to skip filtering for this item and column.

tags.param: column The column from which we want to filter the rows.
tags.returns: The function to call to check if a row pass this filter item or not.

entries.name: getValueAsString
entries.description: Converts the value of a filter item to a human-readable form.

tags.returns: The value formatted to be displayed in the UI of filter button tooltip.

entries.name: headerLabel
entries.description: The label of the filter shown in header filter row.

entries.name: InputComponent
entries.description: The input component to render in the filter panel for this filter operator.

entries.name: InputComponentProps
entries.description: The props to pass to the input component in the filter panel for this filter operator.

entries.name: label
entries.description: The label of the filter operator.

entries.name: requiresFilterValue
entries.description:
If `false`, filter operator doesn't require user-entered value to work.
Usually should be set to `false` for filter operators that don't have `InputComponent` (for example `isEmpty`)
